description: Render a Kodecz video folder to MP4 (GPU with NVENC when there is one, CPU with x264 when not). Returns the render's JSON result line. Run `check` first.

alpha.description: Transparent layer as raw HEVC with alpha (GPU only, no audio)

cpu.description: Render on the CPU even when there is a GPU

folder.description: Video folder (the one with index.html), absolute or relative to the working directory

frames.description: How many frames to render from `from`

id.description: The id in the page's <script type="application/json" id="kodecz"> block

name: render
title: Render a Kodecz video
